description: Small cross-category performance workload for the first local inference baseline.

prompts.prompt: Explain in three concise sentences how quantization reduces the memory required by a language model.
Return only a JSON object with keys risk, cause, and mitigation for the risk of GPU out-of-memory during local inference.
Write a compact Python function named clamp that constrains a numeric value between lower and upper bounds. Include a type hint and no explanation.
A queue receives 18 requests per minute and completes 15 per minute. Starting empty, how many requests are waiting after 12 minutes? Show the short calculation.

Summarize this in one sentence: A local AI runtime validates policy, checks available memory, schedules accepted work, invokes a local model, and records measurements so failures and performance can be inspected.
